paragraph: The Granville composite prints a constructive 63/100 primary reading ahead of the open, reflecting a healthy overall tape free of any active breadth divergence warnings. Internal momentum is anchored by aggressive tech leadership—evidenced by semiconductor relative strength (SOXX/SPY) surging +0.95% and volatility easing -0.84%—while broad breadth (RSP/SPY) and high-beta risk appetite (SPHB/SPLV) both post solid +0.50% gains. Macro conditions comfortably validate this posture: a subdued VIX level of 15.33 rests in a steep contango term structure, high-yield credit spreads remain tight and stable at 2.70%, and falling 10-year real yields at 2.40% offer immediate tailwinds. Additionally, small-cap outperformance at 0.3904 and currency stability (USD/JPY at ¥159.20) confirm that risk-taking is expanding smoothly into broader market pockets without systemic stress. Consequently, the directional lean for today's session is moderately bullish, favoring long positions that capitalize on intraday dips in high-beta and tech momentum.
